messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] high 5xx rate on /v1/generate (inference-service-prod) — 2m spike, 18% error rate :rotating_light:
maya: on it. saw the alert in the dashboard. pulling logs now.
devon: thx maya — are we seeing latency also or just 5xx?
maya: latency steady for most requests, error burst looks tied to a specific model shard. quick grep shows repeated `kv-cache OOM` errors on node-gpu-12.
maya: running mitigation: scaling inference-deployment replicas + enabling fallback routing to cpu-quantized-variant.
maya: command I ran:```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-deployment --replicas=12
# update routing weight to fall back model
curl -X POST https://router.internal/admin/route -d '{"service":"inference","fallback":"cpu-quant-v2","weight":0.35}'
```
devon: nice. did that reduce error rate?
maya: error rate dropped to ~1.6% after scaling + fallback. rolling 30m window looks stable.
azeem: thanks — any customer-facing impact to report?
maya: partial. A handful of requests from two enterprise customers (acme-corp, theta) saw failures during the 12:02-12:10 UTC window. CC: @customer-success to follow up.
devon: filed incident ticket ENG-4827 with initial timeline and mitigations. ticket-bot: created ENG-4827. link: https://tickets.redwood/ENG-4827 :white_check_mark:
maya: notes copied to ticket. immediate root cause suspected kv-cache memory leak on 1.3.4 model runtime. need postmortem.
ron: are there any coverage gaps for next shift? I'm scheduled in 45m and I can take primary if needed.
maya: thanks ron — I was planning to hand off primary to azeem (on call rotation for EU), devon will be secondary. there is a 20m overlap before azeem comes online.
azeem: I can take primary at 13:00 UTC. please leave me the short checklist.
maya: handoff checklist: 1) watch error rate on /v1/generate and /internal/kv-metrics 2) confirm replicas >= 10 3) rollback to cpu-quant-v2 routing if errors spike 4) escalate to infra on persistent kv-cache OOMs. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/kv-cache-leak
maya: quick snippet to check cache metrics:```shell
curl -s http://metrics.internal/kv-cache | jq '.nodes[] | {node: .name, used_mb: .mem.used_mb, evictions: .evictions}'
```
devon: action items before handoff: - add heap snapshot capture on offending nodes (ENG-4827) - increase eviction threshold for KV cache on staging and replicate test (assigned to devon) - add alert for sustained 5xx > 3% for 5m (assigned to ron)
ron: ack, will add the alert and leave details in ENG-4827. ETA 2 hours.
azeem: I reviewed the runbook. can you dump the grep command you used for the OOM lines?
maya: sure:```bash
kubectl -n inference logs inference-pod-gpu-12 --since=30m | grep -E "kv-cache|OOM|evict" -n
```
maya: also note: we had to temporarily disable prefix caching for model v1.3.4 to reduce pressure. that may slightly increase token cost for affected customers; CS already notified.
devon: scheduling a retro for tomorrow 15:00 UTC; invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-runtime, infra, and customer-success. agenda: timeline, RCA plan, followups, SLA/customer comms.
maya: for post-handoff followups: - ENG-4827: root cause RCA + timeline (owner: maya) - ENG-4828: automating heap snapshots and reproducer (owner: devon) - ENG-4829: alert tuning and runbook updates (owner: ron)
ticket-bot: ENG-4828 created. ENG-4829 created.
azeem: taking primary now. I confirm I can access the runbook and the metrics dashboard. i'll monitor the next 2 hours and notify if anything reoccurs.
maya: handing off primary to @azeem. devon you stay on secondary for next 2h?
devon: staying secondary. reachable on pager.
azeem: confirmed primary handoff. leaving a short note in the ticket: "primary handoff at 13:00 UTC to azeem; mitigations applied: scale replicas, fallback routing; customer impact: acme-corp, theta; followups filed ENG-4827/4828/4829."
maya: thanks team. i'm going offline for handoff end-of-shift. please escalate to infra if kv-cache OOMs return. :pray:
ron: added alert, linked to ENG-4829, and added escalation policy to oncall rotation.
devon: will follow up in the retro and check staging reproducer later today.
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] alert on /v1/generate (inference-service-prod) — error rate returned to baseline. resolution summary posted to ENG-4827.
azeem: closing thread but will update if any regressions. :+1:
